relatedChannelTip: Links are created by operators when reporting channel terminals (reporting creates the binding). This drawer is read-only; go to the Channel Terminal Report page to make changes.
registerTips: Manually correct the channel-side terminal number and report status. No request is sent to the channel.
outTerminalNoPlaceholder: Please enter the channel-side terminal number
bindReadOnlyTip: The association is maintained when the channel terminal is reported and shown here read-only
reportSelectTerminal: Select a merchant terminal before reporting
reportNotSupported: This channel does not support auto reporting, register the channel terminal number via the register action
reportLockHintSubmitted: This terminal has been reported, cancel it before changing the merchant terminal
reportLockHintBound: Already linked, reporting will reuse this merchant terminal; unbind first to change it
reportSelectHint: Selecting a merchant terminal creates the link (one channel terminal belongs to only one merchant terminal)
confirmCancel: Cancel this channel terminal? The terminal number will no longer be usable for payment
